summary: feat(settings): adopt Nova icons and illustrations behind the flag
description:
Because:
- Nova replaces FxA's icons and illustrations with acorn-icons and the Mozilla accounts set.
- acorn-icons use context-fill, which renders black outside Firefox chrome.
- Review of the swap surfaced minor Nova UI issues worth fixing alongside it.

This commit:
- Adds Mozilla accounts illustrations, Figma exports and acorn-icons (currentColor), via svgo.
- Adds withNova/sized helpers, sets the Storybook Nova theme and turns Nova on in local.json-dist.
- Sizes Nova status icons at 16px and makes service and account icons follow the text color in dark mode.
- Tweaks Nova UI: Switch sizing and label, choice card spacing/fill/transition, password balloon dark mode, 150ms transitions.
- Documents the asset tables and unswapped list in the design-tokens README.
